title: Ulyana and the Oath
author: Orsen Dravenmoor
blurb: Edmund Galloway, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
